intent.proves: Every flow has at least one step.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(f.EmailMarketingFlowId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(f.EmailMarketingFlowName, N'') FROM EmailMarketingFlow f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EmailMarketingFlowStep s WHERE s.EmailMarketingFlowStepFlowId = f.EmailMarketingFlowId)
